text: Foster carer here, I've had Maya (11 months) for about three weeks so I'm still learning what's normal for her. Temp is 38.3 tonight. Her eczema has flared up too, dry rough patches behind her knees and on her tummy, and she keeps rubbing at them. She also has some red spots on her arms and legs, but we spent most of yesterday in the garden and they're little raised bumps exactly like the mosquito bites I came in with, only on the bits that weren't covered. Mostly ringing so it's on record and to check whether to do anything differently overnight.
